label: drop the framing 0 after the CRC
the frame-boundary 0 before the CRC is dropped
find:
crcAt = segmentAt + DIL_SEGMENT_BITS + DIL_FRAME * dilFrames - 1;
	bits[crcAt] = 0;
why: The removed store is redundant for every descriptor. If dilFrames is nonzero, the last DIL-frame iteration has already written bits[at + 16] at exactly crcAt. If dilFrames is zero, the final segment-field iteration has already written bits[at + 8] at exactly crcAt. Both stores write zero, and no intervening operation changes the position. The object contains the repeated store, so its presence remains code-reconstruction evidence rather than a behavior a fixture can distinguish.
